newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-MIDFIELDER KUEHBAUER SIGNS FOR REAL SOCIEDAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIDFIELDER KUEHBAUER SIGNS FOR REAL SOCIEDAD.

text.p: Austrian international Dietmar Kuehbauer said on Thursday he had signed a three-year contract with Real Sociedad.
The Rapid Vienna midfielder signed for the San Sebastian-based first division club on Wednesday and turned down offers from the German Bundesliga, saying Spain had always attracted him.
"They (Real Sociedad) offered me the best deal," said Kuehbauer, who had also negotiated with Cologne, Stuttgart and Hertha BSC.
The 26-year-old said he got on well with Real Sociedad's new German coach Bern Krauss, a former Rapid Vienna player.
Kuehbauer had almost rejected all offers from abroad because his pregnant wife Michaela is still in a coma following a car crash in February.
"There is nothing I can do for her at the moment so I have decided to fully dedicate myself to soccer," he said. "It helps me forget the tragedy."
